_README: User adjudications that the measurement pipeline cannot express on its own.
Applied by backfill.py ON TOP of colors.json, so re-measuring never loses them.
Every lab value here is MEASURED, not invented — taken from a finer-grained run
of the same extractor. Only the grouping reflects a human decision.
Keep this small: a growing file means the extractor needs fixing instead.

38-realisation-iggy-dress.verdict: black is correct; the accent is mustard yellow, not camel
reason: The gold dots sit on a near-black ground, and the quantiser resolves the
anti-aliased dot edges as their own clusters: a continuous lightness ramp
black L*12 -> chocolate L*24 -> olive L*43 -> camel L*60 -> gold L*76, all at
roughly constant hue. The endpoints are real; the middle is edge blending.
Shading-merge cannot fix this without also merging genuine light/dark prints
(35's black-and-white polka dots), so the grouping is recorded here instead.
Accent lab is the purest measured dot colour (rgb 214,183,121); its coverage
is the summed ramp, because those pixels belong to the dots.
